mapper.sql: c.id, c.user_id as userId, c.item_id as itemId, c.content, c.parent_id as parentId, c.reply_to_comment_id as replyToCommentId, c.reply_to_user_id as replyToUserId, c.create_time as createTime, c.update_time as updateTime, u.id as "userInfo.id", u.username as "userInfo.username", u.avatar_bucket as "userInfo.avatarBucket", u.avatar_object_key as "userInfo.avatarObjectKey", ru.id as "replyToUserInfo.id", ru.username as "replyToUserInfo.username", ru.avatar_bucket as "replyToUserInfo.avatarBucket", ru.avatar_object_key as "replyToUserInfo.avatarObjectKey"
FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user ru ON c.reply_to_user_id = ru.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO comment ( user_id, username, avatar, item_id, content, parent_id, reply_to_comment_id, reply_to_user_id, reply_to_username, reply_to_avatar ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userInfo.username}, #{userInfo.avatar}, #{itemId}, #{content}, #{parentId}, #{replyToCommentId}, #{replyToUserId}, #{replyToUserInfo.username}, #{replyToUserInfo.avatar} )
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM comment WHERE id = #{id} OR parent_id = #{id} OR reply_to_comment_id = #{id}
